No_Tracking_Please.name: No Tracking Please
No_Tracking_Please.summary: Blocks enemy position-reveal requests and quickhack trace acceleration.

UndiscoverMe.name: UndiscoverMe
UndiscoverMe.summary: Reveals eligible undiscovered vanilla map markers without modifying quests.

UndiscoverMe_Teleporter.name: UndiscoverMe Teleporter
UndiscoverMe_Teleporter.summary: Optional UndiscoverMe-core addon: hold the map's Fast Travel action on an UndiscoverMe pin to teleport.

UndiscoverMe_Polish.name: UndiscoverMe — Polski
UndiscoverMe_Polish.summary: Polish text overlay for UndiscoverMe Core and its Teleporter addon.

UndiscoverMe_Korean.name: UndiscoverMe — 한국어
UndiscoverMe_Korean.summary: Korean text overlay for UndiscoverMe Core and its Teleporter addon.

UndiscoverMe_Translation_Sources.name: UndiscoverMe Translation Sources
UndiscoverMe_Translation_Sources.summary: Editable English, Polish and Korean JSON dictionaries for community translators; not a game mod.

Free_Chrome.name: Free Chrome — All Cyberware Costs 0 Humanity
Free_Chrome.summary: Sets standard cyberware Humanity/Capacity costs to zero, with reversible in-game settings.

Camera_Killer.name: Camera Killer
Camera_Killer.summary: Shuts down cameras connected to the same access point or surveillance system when V turns off one camera.

Weight_Customizer.name: Weight Customizer
Weight_Customizer.summary: Change V's carry capacity from 50 to 5000 kg through M1 Arc, with live updates and reversible modifiers.

Daemon.name: Daemon
Daemon.summary: Automatically solves Cyberpunk 2077 Breach Protocol puzzles by selecting valid cells in the original minigame. Requires M1 Arc 1.0.0.
